verdict: ACCEPTED with REVIEWs. Round 4 reads the film as D-62 plays it: only Brad and Vance are heard; 149 lines of real people are bubbles (about 5.8 of an estimated 14.3 minutes, 41 %). It still plays as a mini-film: no line of a bubble exceeds 14 words, pieces are 1-12 words (median 3-4), every silent run is cut with a new shot every 4-6 s, and every silent exchange is bracketed by a narrator line. The cost is in the sound: four silent runs (S08, S10, S13, S15) have no music, ten silent runs are 20-40 s of pure reading, and about 36 text overlays repeat what the bubble beside them already says. No FAIL, no blocker. Hash re-bound after the coordinator's reference records (library p_*, look.environment, cast.<hero>.reference); words, shots, audio and Shorts unchanged.

findings.expected: A silent exchange reads as a comic panel: the bubble carries the words, the picture carries the acting.
findings.instructed: Beats were written for spoken lines: a text/label beat echoes the heard keyword (SC/VB: the picture reinforces the word). 30 text, 5 label and 50 symbol beats sit on silent lines.
findings.conflict: On a silent line the viewer has just read the same words in the bubble; an overlay FORTY DOLLARS, TEN PERCENT, LUCKY, OWNED ALL EIGHT repeats it a second later, next to the bubble (VB-07 two-overlay limit already breached in SH05, SH06).
findings.consequence: Reading load and clutter in the 20-40 s reading runs; the overlays stop being emphasis and become noise, the joke 'LUCKY' under 'you got lucky with him' is flattened.
findings.fix: On silent lines keep expression beats and only text/symbol beats that add something the bubble does not say (a number, a date, a callback label); delete echoes of the bubble's own words, starting with S02 L7/L9/L15, S04 L8/L10/L12/L14/L15, S15 L6/L11/L15/L17.

findings.expected: In a scene the narrator does not carry, music or sound carries the mood (S08 ultimatum tense, S10 comic, S13 warm release, S15 twist).
findings.instructed: music[] cues run only from <start> to 'Year one', 'In the parking lot'..'Year two', 'Year three'..'The next morning', 'Year five'..'Five years after', 'Ten men walked out'..; these gaps were made when the dialogue was voiced and music stayed out of its way.
findings.conflict: The four scenes with the longest silent runs (S08 22 s, S10 35 s, S13 33 s, S15 41 s) have only a -27 dB bed and one sfx each; nothing scores the emotion while the eyes read.
findings.consequence: The film's turn (S08), its release (S13) and its twist (S15) play on a bare ambience: the reading runs feel like pauses, not scenes; drop-off risk at 6:30, 8:00, 10:30 and 13:00 (estimate).
findings.fix: Extend the existing tracks under S08, S10, S13 and S15 at about -30 dB (same ducking against narrator and Vance), with a tension edge on S08, a swell on S13 L8-L11 and a held note under S15 L11-L17; no new track needed.

findings.expected: The pivot words ('Yes.', 'We do.', 'Double.', 'Eight?') land with a held beat before the next change (midpoint S08).
findings.instructed: silent.hold: BP-27 gives a one-word bubble 0.83 s, plus 0.35 s lead and 0.35 s tail, then the narrator ('Cuban signs.').
findings.conflict: A spoken 'Yes.' would carry its own weight; a one-word bubble is read in half a second and the narrator speaks 1.2 s later. The landing_thud__v2 is on 'Five hundred.' (S08 L5), not on 'Yes.'.

findings.fix: Give S08 L10 and S13 L6 a held reaction shot of about 2 s after the bubble (hold on the shot, quiet bed, no narrator), and move or add a low sfx on 'Yes.'.

findings.expected: Cut notes describe cuts that exist in the silent film (cut between bubble pieces, BUBBLE-5).
findings.instructed: S02 shot 4 cut: "L-cut: Musk's voice starts under O'Leary's face"; S04 shot 6 "L-cut: the picture trails Belfort's first words"; S13 shot 5 "L-cut: Musk's voice leads"; S02 shot 7 "a third voice breaks the alternation".
